assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All three scope boundaries and the three key-area polygons are provisional rough polygons (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false) derived from the public announcement text and announced areas.
assumptions.impact: Land-use areas, green/public-space ratios, building footprint share, corridor length, and all area-based metrics must be recalculated in EPSG:4548 when official polygons arrive; provisional values are for concept display and intake self-check only.

assumptions.statement: Land-use partition, building footprints, road centerlines, green/public space, constraints, and phasing are AI-generated conceptual design layers, not existing-condition survey data.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints and renewal projects must not be read as existing buildings, approved schemes, or parcel-level demolition conclusions.

assumptions.statement: All 12 AI scenario cards are conceptual proposals; none is approved, deployed, or under contract.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios require scenario-owner review, human-checkpoint operations, and compliance with privacy and AI-governance rules before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: The annual event system, developer-community operations, and conversion pathways are conceptual designs, not confirmed government or organizer arrangements.
assumptions.impact: No event, fund, policy, or investment described in the proposal may be presented as committed.

assumptions.statement: The statutory heritage protection scope (purple line) and construction control zone for Juesheng Temple (Dazhongsi) are not available; the heritage coordination zone, view corridors, and height-gradient directions in the Dazhongsi cluster are conceptual only, and the Dazhongsi station four-quadrant walking ring is anchored on the provisional key-area centroid rather than a surveyed station location.
assumptions.impact: Heritage-related design directions must be verified against official protection data and a professional heritage impact assessment before implementation; no statutory conclusion is implied.
